referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Partial Veto Referendum - QUESTION 1
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 1: “Partial veto. Shall section 10 (1) (c) of article V of the constitution be amended to prohibit the governor, in exercising his or her partial veto authority, from creating or increasing or authorizing the creation or increase of any tax or fee?”

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Freedom to Gather in Places of Worship During an Emergency Referendum - QUESTION 2
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 2: "Freedom to gather in places of worship during an emergency. Shall section 18 of article I of the constitution, which deals with religious liberty, be amended to prohibit the state or a political subdivision of the state from ordering the closure of, or forbidding gatherings in, places of worship in response to a state of emergency, including a public health emergency?"

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Governmental Entity Discrimination Prohibited Referendum - QUESTION 3
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 3: "Governmental entity discrimination prohibited. Shall section 27 of article I of the constitution be created to prohibit governmental entities in the state from discriminating against, or granting preferential treatment to, any individual or group on the basis of race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin in public employment, public education, public contracting, or public administration?"

referendums.name: Green Bay Area Public School District Exceed Revenue Limit Referendum
referendums.area: Green Bay Area Public School District
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the Green Bay Area Public School District, Brown County, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $29,000,000 for the 2027-2028 school year, by $36,000,000 for the 2028-2029 school year, by $44,000,000 for the 2029-2030 school year, and by $49,000,000 for the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes including funding educational programs, staffing, and other operational expenses?

referendums.name: Pulaski School District General Obligation Bonds for School Facility Improvements Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question:  Shall the Pulaski Community School District, Brown, Oconto, Shawano and Outagamie Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to issue pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $59,800,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of a school facility improvement project consisting of: construction of an addition and renovations at Lannoye Elementary School, including for classrooms, special education, and support spaces; renovations at Pulaski Community Middle School in Career and Technology Education (CTE), including Technology and Engineering Education, Agriscience, Family and Consumer Science, and Business and Information Technology classroom spaces, and conversion of the existing pool to a multi-purpose activity facility; construction of additions and renovations at Pulaski High School, including for a community swimming pool facility, a fitness/weight center, wrestling space, additions and renovations to Career and Technology Education (CTE) classroom spaces in select program areas, renovations to classrooms and labs, and construction of tennis courts and parking lot expansion; district-wide capital maintenance, building systems and site improvements; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and equipment?

referendums.name: West De Pere School District Exceed Revenue Limits Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the School District of West De Pere, Brown and Outagamie Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $4,900,000 per year for five years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2031-2032 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational and maintenance expenses?
